verdicts.reason: "Each capability listed here will need a corresponding spec file" directly supports checking listed capabilities have specs.
"Every change must either declare at least one capability ... or explicitly opt out" supports a should-level declared check.
"Create specification files that define WHAT the system should do" directly requires the spec artifact to exist.
"Good spec content: ... Scenarios that can be tested" is advisory guidance, appropriately captured at should level.
"Create one spec file per capability listed in the proposal's Capabilities section" is a direct instruction matching listed_have_specs.
"Do not rewrite an existing file unless the user asks you to" directly supports a no_rewrite discipline check.
"There must be at least one spec file unless ... skip_specs: true" supports checking spec existence.
"If the proposal lists no capabilities and skip_specs is not set, revisit the proposal" supports a should-level declared check.
"Delta operations (use ## headers): ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED Requirements" directly defines the header format checked.
"RENAMED Requirements: Name changes only - use FROM:/TO: format" directly mandates the format.
"Use SHALL/MUST for normative requirements (avoid should/may)" is a direct imperative matching the shall_must rule.
"Do NOT add `## Purpose` to a delta for an existing capability" is an explicit prohibition.
"Sections: - **Context**" lists Context as a design section, fitting a should-level presence check.
The text only says "Reference the proposal for motivation"; requiring the literal "proposal.md" comes from the "e.g." example and is stricter than written.
"**Decisions**: Key technical choices with rationale" is a listed design section.
"**Risks / Trade-offs**: Known limitations" is a listed design section.
"Format: [Risk] → Mitigation" explicitly prescribes the arrow format for that section.
"requires: - proposal" establishes that proposal precedes design.
"Create the task list that breaks down the implementation work" directly requires the tasks artifact.
"IMPORTANT: Follow the template below for tracked tasks. The apply phase parses checkbox format" supports checking for checkbox tasks.
